down_walk.prompt:
Create a redesigned game walk animation ROW of exactly THREE separate full-body drawings of the SAME upright biped puppy. Reference 1 is the locked appearance and COLOR MASTER. Reference 2 is the old sprite contact board for design/camera reference only; its gait is NOT authoritative. Preserve the exact pale apricot/golden coat, ivory muzzle/chest/paw tips, brown eyes, dark brown contours, floppy ears and proportions from reference 1, no richer orange, no extra shading or gradients. Clean readable outlined cel art matching reference, not pixel art. One horizontal row, 3 equally scaled whole puppies with generous blank gaps. Solid cyan #00FFFF background, no text, no panels, no floor, no shadows. All limbs fully visible without cropping. This is a WALK, not a march: modest relaxed opposing arm swing with soft elbows, short natural strides and slight coupled head/torso bounce; expression stays same small closed smile, eyes same, no face pasted frozen. CRITICAL: two legs alternate steps and two arms swing in opposition to THEIR SAME-SIDE LEGS, i.e. right leg forward WITH left arm forward; then opposite. A and B must be genuinely different opposite limb configurations, NOT identical lower bodies with different arms. Neutral between them. No paw pads, no beans, no colored sole ovals, no exposed sole panels at all; lifted paws stay continuous fur with modest toe lines. Keep tail rooted and shape/color consistent, modest motion only. No accessories or clothes.
FRONT view facing viewer throughout. Drawing1 contact A: character's RIGHT leg (screen LEFT) steps FORWARD/down and LEFT leg(screen RIGHT) stays behind/up; LEFT arm(screen RIGHT) swings forward bent hand beside chest, RIGHT arm(screen LEFT) goes back beside hip. Drawing2 neutral: feet under hips, relaxed arms at sides. Drawing3 contact B: LEFT leg(screen RIGHT) steps FORWARD/down and RIGHT leg(screen LEFT) behind/up; RIGHT arm(screen LEFT) forward and LEFT arm(screen RIGHT) back. Grounded forward foot is lower and slightly larger than rear foot; both remain fur-covered. Same front camera for all3.
